headlines.title: Microsoft services hit by major outage across the world
headlines.description: A widespread outage continued to hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Friday, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected Chinese spy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Howard Lutnick agrees to testify as bipartisan pressure grows over Nvidia scandal
headlines.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was also requested to testify, had previously praised the commerce secretary for his support and involvement in the industry.

headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after Huang resigns, weighing on broader market
headlines.description: Stocks declined at the opening bell on news that Jensen Huang, one of the most important executives in the AI boom, resigned as CEO of Nvidia.

headlines.title: Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia’s new interim CEO?
headlines.description: For 13 years, Colette Kress helped manage the company’s transformation from a graphics-chip maker into the company at the center of the AI boom.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang out as NVIDIA CEO
headlines.description: Following reports connecting him to extramarital relationships with multiple women, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigned. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: Widespread outage of Microsoft apps used by hundreds of millions
headlines.description: Essential workplace tools like Outlook email were unavailable for many in global outages today. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports on details of the outage.

headlines.title: Widespread outage hits Microsoft platforms including Outlook, thousands report issues
headlines.description: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant’s suite of apps. NBC News' Marquise Francis reports on why this error is occurring.

headlines.title: The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
headlines.description: Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.

headlines.title: Trump recommends Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: President Trump weighed in on the search for a permanent CEO shortly after Nvidia’s announcement about Jensen Huang's resignation, saying that Apple executive chair Tim Cook should take the role. NBC News' Allie Canal and New York Times contributor Don Clark discuss Cook's industry experience and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress.

headlines.title: Nvidia shares tumble after Huang resignation
headlines.description: NBC News’ Allie Canal details the drop in Nvidia shares after Jensen Huang resigned as the CEO of Nvidia in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Ring CEO unveils new indoor home security drone
headlines.description: Amazon’s Ring has unveiled an indoor drone for home monitoring that users can manually operate to investigate disturbances. Ring founder and chief inventor Jamie Siminoff discusses the new surveillance robotics and how AI is used to pilot it.
